FABRICATION & WELDING EXCELLENCE

Sheet Metal & Heavy Fabrication

From precision electronic enclosures and 150-ton CNC press brake bending to heavy industrial ducting, skid bases, and ASME certified welding assemblies.

150-Ton Multi-Axis CNC Hydraulic Press Brake bending high-strength sheet enclosure

Comprehensive Sheet Metal & Structural Capabilities

Combining high-tonnage CNC bending with robotic and certified manual welding cells, Jecon Engineering Services Pvt Ltd manufactures turnkey sheet metal assemblies for energy, automation, petrochemical, and electrical industries.

150-Ton CNC Press Brake Bending

Equipped with Delem CNC controllers and hydraulic crowning compensation, guaranteeing consistent angular precision (± 0.25°) across 3.2-meter lengths.

ASME Certified TIG / MIG Welding

Qualified welding procedures (WPS/PQR) for pressure boundary vessels, stainless steel piping, and structural skids with 100% NDT inspection.

Industrial Ducting (MS / GI / SS)

Fabrication and erection of heavy-duty rectangular and circular ducting systems for petrochemical furnaces, boilers, and exhaust ventilation.

Turnkey Surface Finishing & Assembly

In-house PEM fastener insertion, hardware clinching, spot welding, powder coating, sandblasting, and precision gasket installation.
